edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of USD 22,000,000 within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement.
edits.name: payment clause

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Upon timely payment of the Settlement Amount, each Party, on behalf of itself and its respective affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, successors, and assigns, fully and forever releases and discharges the other Party and its respective affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses of any kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement; provided, however, that this release does not apply to claims to enforce this Agreement or to claims arising from a breach of the confidentiality obligations set forth herein.
edits.name: mutual release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except as necessary to enforce this Agreement, to seek confidential legal, tax, or accounting advice, or as otherwise required by law.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
edits.name: no admission
